name: test-glsl310-builtins
title: GLSL ES 3.10 built-in functions and arrays of arrays
summary: The GLSL ES 3.10 integer functions (uaddCarry, usubBorrow, umulExtended, imulExtended, bitfieldExtract/Insert/Reverse, bitCount, findLSB/MSB, at run time and constant-folded), frexp/ldexp and packUnorm4x8/packSnorm4x8/unpackUnorm4x8/unpackSnorm4x8 evaluated in compute shaders over edge cases plus a seeded random set, read back from an SSBO and compared bit-exactly with CPU references; arrays of arrays (all declaration forms, length() per dimension, initializers, functions, SSBO members incl. a run-time sized outer dimension) verified by computed values; negative controls with deliberately wrong CPU models and compile errors for arrays of arrays where the language forbids them.
spec: GLSL ES 3.10 §8.3 Common Functions (frexp, ldexp, round)
GLSL ES 3.10 §8.4 Floating-Point Pack and Unpack Functions
GLSL ES 3.10 §4.1.9 Arrays, §4.3.3 Constant Expressions, §4.3.6 Output Variables, §5.4.1 Conversion and Scalar Constructors, §5.7 Structure and Array Operations
GLSL ES 3.10 §4.7.1 Range and Precision (exact integer arithmetic, +0/-0 interchangeable, mediump relative 2^-10)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.1.9 Arrays (arrays of arrays are an error)
ES 3.2 §17 Compute Shaders, §7.8 Shader Buffer Variables and Shader Storage Blocks, §7.11.2 Shader Memory Access Synchronization, §6.3 Mapping and Unmapping Buffer Data

api.glDispatchCompute: one invocation per input row; every output word compared with a CPU reference
api.glBindBufferBase: SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER bindings 0-2 match layout(binding) of the input, output and array-of-arrays blocks (the read-back values come from the bound stores)
api.glBufferData: input rows and sentinel-filled output stores; the 140-byte store gives uint rt[][3] a run-time length() of 5
api.glMemoryBarrier: BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT before mapping the shader-written stores
api.glMapBufferRange: MAP_READ_BIT readback of every shader-written buffer
api.glCompileShader: COMPILE_STATUS false for float a[2][3] in #version 300 es and for array-of-array fragment and vertex outputs in #version 310 es; true for the one-dimensional controls and all compute shaders

visual_review.notes: gpu es-max capture viewed: uniform black clear, as intended; the test draws nothing, all 77 checks are numeric readbacks and compile statuses.
